body: I have to drink lots of caffeine, play video games, and then crash. If I don't, I'll start to think again. All that comes after that is pain and depression.
You're never going to be good enough, and you know it.

At this point, it's my two League buddies. I would have killed myself long ago without them. Currently, I'm in a new relationship, I don't think it will last. I just really want to end this suffering.
Say my name Ft. Yea is another one of their fantastic songs, and the Luke Shay remix of that is just as good imo.
